entities.name: Myojin of Seeing Winds
entities.description: Myojin kami of blue magic on Kamigawa, who turned against the material world during the Kami War.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Person whose crime threw the Myojin into chaos and anger.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War that began when the kami turned against the material world.

entities.name: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams
entities.description: Another Myojin representing an aspect of blue magic.

events.summary: Because of Konda's crime the Myojin fall into chaos and anger and turn against the material world as the Kami War begins.
events.quote: like all other kami, the Myojin turned against the material world.
